thread:
alicia: heads up — saw a billing discrepancy for customer acct C-718. fallback routing to quantized-v2 produced two charge events for the same logical stream. looks like double-counting.
ben: can you paste the trace ids + any ledger event ids? :eyes:
alicia: trace: route=route-9f3 req=req-usr-123 session=s-7. runtime frames show router->quantized fallback mid-stream. ledger has charge events: charge#111 and charge#112 that sum tokens twice.
carlos: this smells like we spawn a new session on fallback. our dedupe key today is session_id+seq_range so a new session will bypass dedupe.
emma: customer-facing issue: console showed "estimated tokens" during the stream then final invoice was higher. customers are confused about provisional vs final.
dana: product note — we should avoid surprise spikes. suggestion: expose "provisional (in-progress)" estimate and flag if final differs >10%.
ben: technical proposal: propagate a stable Charge-Id from edge through runtime to ledger so all charge events for the same logical request share the same id. ledger can dedupe on Charge-Id.
alicia: example header we can add at the edge and keep through retries/fallbacks:
```
X-Charge-Id: req-usr-123-7
X-Route-Id: route-9f3
```
edge pseudocode:
```
headers['X-Charge-Id'] = f"{req_id}-{attempt}"
```
runtime should emit charge events as:
```
emit_charge_event(charge_id=headers['X-Charge-Id'], tokens=n)
```

carlos: agree but we should include `attempt` and `fallback_tag` in the id or as labels for telemetry. also include `frame_seq` to make per-frame dedupe idempotent.
ben: also need idempotency window in ledger (ignore duplicate charge events with same charge_id within 60s). and add `frame_seq` so partial retries don't double-count.
emma: UX workflow: console should show "provisional tokens (dedupe pending)" with a tooltip: "Final token count is confirmed after the session closes. fallbacks and retries may change the final amount." add small banner on invoices if >10% variance.
dana: add alerting to billing ops if customers >$X see >20% variance in one stream.
infra-bot: deploy-bot: canary rollout started for `charge_id_propagation` -> eng-runtime @1% :rocket:
ben: corner case — truncation + toolcalls. when runtime truncates a stream mid-toolcall we sometimes emit both toolcall-chunk and fallback frames, ledger sees both. charge_id + frame_seq should handle that, but runtime must ensure it attaches same charge_id when it spawns fallback streams.
alicia: i'll open a single PR touching edge header injection, runtime emission, and ledger dedupe logic + console UX bits. cc @ben @carlos for review. i'll include a sample trace and a failing metering-test.
ben: sounds good. :thumbsup:
carlos: i'll add a replay test in metering-tests to simulate mid-stream route switch and truncation.
emma: assign a small UX task to show provisional/confirmed labels on the session detail page.
dana: once rolled out, let's run a 7-day recon and notify top 10 customers if we see significant adjustments.
infra-bot: deploy-bot: canary rollout log: feature=charge_id_propagation status=started pct=1 env=staging
